title: Underlying sectionwise proper/open counit is monic
statement: With the hypotheses of the proper/open counit, applying the forgetful functor from ringed-site modules to presheaves of modules to the counit component yields a monomorphism.

source.place: Injectivity half of the affine proper/open support argument (Tags 09AE and 09AG)

proof.text: For any fixed-scalar sheaf N on T, apply the proved source-library criterion ProEtale.mono_of_mono_openImmersionLowerShriekAdjunction_unit_app_comp to the counit of openImmersionLowerShriekAdjunction. Its transpose is the identity of the restriction of N by the right triangle identity, hence is monic. The criterion proves sectionwise injectivity using the empty-or-terminal localization comma categories and exact sheafification.

Expand the specified intrinsic adjunction as the composite of the inverse coefficient equivalence adjunction, the fixed-scalar open adjunction, and the target coefficient equivalence adjunction. The composite-counit formula expresses its component as an equivalence image of a composite of an isomorphism with the preceding monic counit, followed by an isomorphism. Equivalences preserve monomorphisms, so every intrinsic counit component is monic.

Specialize to the displayed proper direct image of the open extension of M. The forgetful functor from module sheaves to module presheaves preserves finite limits and therefore monomorphisms. Its image of this intrinsic counit component is the required monomorphism. Properness is not needed for this injectivity half.
